text: Two young Mormon missionaries, Sister Paxton and Sister Barnes, call on Mr. Reed in Boulder, Colorado, and step inside when he says his wife is baking a blueberry pie. The smell [comes from a scented candle|rules|reality comes apart], [the front door is locked on a timer|images|the house and its rooms], and Reed, a long student of theology, picks apart their faith before offering two doors marked for belief and disbelief. Both lead down to the basement, where he promises [a resurrection they must witness|threat|evil places].
